language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hello, I am Tim.
Hello and welcome to Antarctica! My name is Amelia. I'm working on an iceberg studying the speed of the animals here. Will you help me?

I’ll show you how it works! To determine how fast an animal travels, you use the calculation for
speed: speed = distance ÷ time

For example, let's calculate the speed at which a penguin can slide across the ice. I just measured that this penguin here took 10 seconds to slide 10 meters. So, that is 10 divided by 10, which is... 1! That means that it travels at 1 meter per second.
Let’s see how fast other animals can travel! I hope I’m not the slowest!

I need help calculating the speed of these animals. On Antartica, we calculate the speed in kilometers per hour. So that means that you calculate the speed by dividing the kilometers by the hours. Can you help me calculate the speed of each animal?

Sometimes the animals have to slow down and swim around icebergs. This means they don't always swim at a constant speed. We're going to need to figure out how long it takes the animals to swim to distances with different speeds.

helperSimple.text: To figure this one out, first calculate the distance of the first leg. Then calculate the distance of the second leg. Finally, add up the two distances to get to the total distance the animal travelled!

How far did Parker travel?
